headline: No sugar shortage in India, prices may fall soon; ISMA explains reason for price rise
summary: ISMA said there is no sugar shortage in India and retail prices could come down in the coming period. It attributed the recent price rise to a production decline caused by bad weather.
why: Sugar is a key agricultural commodity in India, and the Indian Sugar Mills Association (ISMA) represents producers whose output drives domestic supply and prices.
